name: Valentina Herrera
bio:
Valentina's journey in motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines alongside her grandfather, a mechanic in Buenos Aires. This early exposure ignited a passion that led her to pursue a degree in engineering, specializing in automotive design. After graduating, she gained valuable experience working with a smaller racing team, where she honed her technical skills and developed a keen eye for detail. 

Her organizational prowess and ability to motivate others quickly propelled her into management roles. Valentina is known for her collaborative approach, fostering a positive and productive team environment. She believes in empowering her team members and encouraging innovation at every level. Her strategic thinking and commitment to continuous improvement make her a valuable asset to any racing organization.

Valentina's unique ability to bridge the gap between technical expertise and effective management sets her apart. She's not afraid to get her hands dirty, and her deep understanding of the technical aspects of racing allows her to make informed decisions that drive performance and efficiency.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail during races, but styled more loosely otherwise.
physical.description: Valentina is of average height with a lean, athletic build, reflecting her active lifestyle.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deeply focused on a problem.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a quick round of mate, a traditional Argentine tea.
